questions.text: Convert denary 173 to eight-bit binary and hexadecimal.
Represent −37 in eight-bit two’s complement. Show the conversion.

answer.text: Invert and add one to give 11011011

questions.text: Add 01110110 and 00101101 as eight-bit unsigned integers. State whether overflow occurs.

answer.text: No unsigned overflow; the result is 163, within 0–255

questions.text: A 640 × 480 image uses 16 bits per pixel. Calculate its uncompressed pixel size in bytes.
